title: Prefix addition and absence of carry
statement: For Boolean sequences $A,B,C$ and a natural number $i$, the conjunction of the agreement indicator at $i$ with the negation of the carry bit at $i$ equals true if and only if the value of the first $i$ bits of $C$ is the sum of the values of the first $i$ bits of $A$ and $B$.
hypotheses_covered: $A,B,C$ are Boolean sequences indexed by the natural numbers
